name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Peach Mango
description: Peach Mango is sunshine with a candy-coated crunch. Juicy peach brings a soft, nectar-like sweetness while ripe mango adds a bright tropical punch, all rolled in tiny, colorful crunchy candies that make the fruit flavors pop. Crack through the candy-coated outside and you’ll hit two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy, delivering that signature Double-Stacked contrast.
